title: Tensions rise ahead of US-Iran nuclear talks
text: Tensions rise ahead of US-Iran nuclear talksLiveNOW’s Austin Westfall is speaking with Prof. Alon Burstein from the @Israel-Palestine-Report as leaders from the U.S. and Iran are set to meet on Friday with tensions remaining high between the two nations. FOX's Rebekah Castor reports that the White House wants to end Iran's nuclear program, but Iranian officials are making several last-minute demands. According to early reports, Secretary of State Marco Rubio says that Iran requested to change locations for talks with its U.S. counterparts. "We thought we had an established forum that had been agreed to in Turkey. It was put together by a number of partners who wanted to attend and be a part of it," Rubio said when taking questions from reporters this week. "The Iranian people and the Iranian regime are very unalike," Rubio previously said. "The leadership of Iran at the clerical level does not reflect the people of Iran. I know of no other country where there's a bigger difference between the people that lead the country and the people who live there."
